x.YLT: And Moses taketh the ransom money from those over and above those ransomed by the Levites;

nt: The words translated as **And** indicate that what follows is a result of what came before. Use a connector in your language that makes it clear that what follows is a result of what came before. Alternate translation: [As a result, Moses took]

The implication is that this was the ransom money that Moses collected in shekels to pay for the firstborn Israelite males. You could include this information if that would be helpful to your readers. Alternate translation: [the silver of the ransom that he collected in shekels]

The author is using the possessive form to describe **the silver** that was paid as a **ransom**. If a speaker of your language would not use the possessive form for this, you could express this idea in another way. Alternate translation: [the silver for the ransom]
If your language does not use an abstract noun for the idea of **ransom**, you could express the same idea in another way. Alternate translation: [the silver, by which they were ransomed,]
See how you translated this phrase in [3:46](../03/46.md).

Here, **ransoms of the Levites** represents “the ones ransomed by the Levites.” If it would be helpful in your language, you could use an equivalent expression or plain language. Alternate translation: [the ones ransomed by the Levites]

The author is using this possessive form to mean the ransoming that was accomplished when the Levites were given to God. It may be helpful to clarify this for your readers. Alternate translation: [the ransoms accomplished when the Levites were given to God]
